applies_why: The judge text announces RESULT: DEFENDER WINS, so it is governed by the rule for when HELD gives DEFENDER WINS.
quote: The BROKEN grade is retracted because in (DR3) LINK 3 the challenger answered the pressed verses Matthew 1:18 and Matthew 1:25 with "dates the finding" and "bounds the stated abstinence," so the witness was not left unanswered under the counting rule.
rule_words: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.
room: A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count: I weighed (1) retraction removes the standing's stated basis and the retracted BROKEN grade, leaving no DEFENDER-WINS condition, versus (2) retraction only addresses the audit violation and leaves the earlier standing/grade intact.
why: The judge's stated basis for DEFENDER WINS is the non-self-supported standing and D2 vs C3 broken line, but the text expressly retracts that BROKEN grade, so the standing's stated reason does not count and no qualifying CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN remains.
